pages.title: Gaur
pages.text: The gaur ($(o)Bos gaurus$()) is a wild bovine native to South and Southeast Asia, where it lives in forests and the grassy clearings around them.$(br2)It is the largest living wild bovine, with bulls standing up to two metres at the shoulder.$(br2)Gaur have a prominent muscular ridge along the back and pale lower legs that look like white stockings. They live in small herds led by adult cows.
